# DahVio Studios

> Solo developer, veteran, and father building mobile apps and web properties from Long Beach, California. DahVio Studios ships real products that solve real problems.

DahVio Studios is an independent software studio founded by Ray Ro. The studio produces iOS apps built with Flutter, Chrome extensions, and web properties. The military fitness app suite provides free, official-standards-based fitness calculators for all branches of the U.S. military.

## Military Fitness Apps

- [Marine PFT Calculator 2026](https://dahvio.com/marine-pft-calculator-2026): Instant Marine Corps PFT scoring based on MCO 6100.13A. Covers pull-ups or push-ups, plank, and 3-mile run, with the 2026 combat arms standard and a waist-to-height check. Max 300 points.
- [Marine CFT Calculator 2026](https://dahvio.com/marine-cft-calculator-2026): Marine Corps Combat Fitness Test scoring on the MCO 6100.13A tables: Movement to Contact, Ammunition Lift, and Maneuver Under Fire, with CFT class. Max 300 points.
- [Marine PFT & CFT Score Chart 2026](https://dahvio.com/marine-pft-cft-score-chart-2026): Every Marine PFT and CFT event by age group and sex, with the full point-by-point tables from MCO 6100.13A.
- [Air Force PT Calculator 2026](https://dahvio.com/air-force-pt-calculator-2026): Instant USAF and Space Force PFA scoring based on DAFMAN 36-2905. Composite score across body composition, aerobic fitness, push-ups, and core. Supports altitude adjustment.
- [Navy PRT Calculator 2026](https://dahvio.com/navy-prt-calculator-2026): Instant Navy PRT scoring based on OPNAVINST 6110.1L. Covers push-ups, plank, and cardio (1.5-mile run, 2 km row, 500-yard or 450-meter swim). The three event scores are averaged into a performance category.
- [Army AFT Calculator 2026](https://dahvio.com/army-aft-calculator-2026): Instant Army AFT scoring based on FM 7-22. All five events: 3-rep max deadlift, hand release push-ups, sprint-drag-carry, plank, and 2-mile run. Max 500 points. The AFT replaced the ACFT.
- [Military Waist-to-Height Ratio Calculator](https://dahvio.com/military-waist-to-height-calculator): Checks one height and waist against the 2026 Marine Corps (0.52), Army and Navy (under 0.55), and Air Force (PFA points) waist-to-height standards and the DoD limit in DoWI 1308.03.

## Military Career Apps

- [BriefBuilder](https://dahvio.com/epb-builder): Air Force EPB builder app for enlisted Airmen, on the App Store (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/air-force-epb-brief-builder/id6835032478). Free to start with 5 AI rewrites; unlimited rewrites at $3.99/month, $14.99/year, or $24.99 lifetime. Log accomplishments throughout the reporting period, tag them to the four Major Performance Areas, and turn them into narrative EPB performance statements that fit each 350-character block.

## Other Apps

- [Hydrate or Diedrate](https://dahvio.com/hydrate): Water tracker with a dark sense of humor. Fast-log servings, a status system from Desiccating to Preserved, and reminders that read like official dehydration notices.
- [Rant & Private Burn Journal](https://dahvio.com/rant): Private iPhone journal for messy thoughts, voice notes, Sparks, and letting go (formerly Ember Journal). Write what you can't text. Keep what helps. Burn what doesn't.
- [Confidence Daily](https://confidencedaily.app): Premium wellness app with an 8-week structured confidence-building program. Daily practices and progress tracking.
- [MySocialBattery](https://mysocialbattery.app): Social energy tracking app for introverts.
- [SplitSecond Pay](https://splitsecondpay.com): iOS bill-splitting app for real-world use.

## Games

- [Paper Football](https://dahvio.com/paper-football): Free browser game of tabletop paper football. Swipe to flick the folded note, hang it off the far edge for a touchdown, and kick extra points through finger goalposts. Play the computer, pass and play with a friend, or try the desk-fan kicking challenge. iPhone version in development.

## Chrome Extensions

- [LoadOut](https://loadout.page): Project workspaces for Chrome. Turns the new tab into a home base for your projects, with each project's links, saved tabs, modes and next step one click away. No account; data stays in the browser.
- [EchoPost](https://dahvio.com/echopost): Turns an Instagram caption into a Google Business Profile post with the right post type, length and call-to-action button. Free plan: 5 rewrites per month.
- [WordBridge](https://dahvio.com/wordbridge): Vocabulary builder and dictionary. Highlight a word for its definition, pronunciation and a translation in 12 languages; it saves with the sentence you found it in. Four study modes. Free, no account; data stays in the browser.
- [Local Schema Helper](https://localschemahelper.com): Generate JSON-LD structured data for local businesses. Built for SEO professionals.
- Citation Manager: Local SEO Citation Manager for Google Business Profile. Audits NAP consistency.
